title.value: Knowledge Transfer through Value Function for Compositional Tasks

abstract.value: Deep Reinforcement Learning methods are sample inefficient when exploring the environment from scratch. In this work, we introduce an approach of knowledge transfer using the value function combined with curriculum learning, which aims to leverage the learning process by transferring knowledge among progressively increasing task complexity. Our main contribution is demonstrating the effectiveness of this approach by modifying the degrees of freedom of the target task, breaking it down into simpler sub-tasks, and transferring the knowledge along the curriculum steps. We empirically demonstrate the broad possibilities of modifying the degrees of freedom of the target task to leverage learning in classical Reinforcement Learning problems and a real-world control task.
